node.name: SMB
node.rich_text: SMB Command Description smbclient -N -L //<FQDN/IP> Null session authentication on SMB. smbclient //<FQDN/IP>/<share> Connect to a specific SMB share. rpcclient -U "" <FQDN/IP> Interaction with the target using RPC. samrdump.py <FQDN/IP> Username enumeration using Impacket scripts. smbmap -H <FQDN/IP> Enumerating SMB shares. crackmapexec smb <FQDN/IP> --shares -u '' -p '' Enumerating SMB shares using null session authentication. enum4linux-ng.py <FQDN/IP> -A SMB enumeration using enum4linux.
